name: Inductor
description: Ideal inductor with optional winding resistance and initial current.

inductance.doc: Inductance (motional inductances of low-frequency crystals reach kilohenries)

tolerance.doc: Tolerance: each part's inductance lies within this band of the nominal, drawn from the project's seed (ADR-034). 20 % is IEC 60062's code M, the usual grade of power inductors; 0 for an exact part.

ic.doc: Initial current at t=0 (pin 1 to pin 2)

timed.claims: As electrical when its nets are analog; otherwise a wire.

electrical.claims: Linear inductance with series dcr and initial current; branch current is a solver unknown (SPEC-004 §7 inductor); each instance's inductance drawn uniformly inside ±tolerance of the nominal from the project's seed and its id (ADR-034; nominal with settings.imperfections "ideal").
omissions: the distribution inside the tolerance band (uniform: a manufacturer guarantees the band only)
